device.description: quad 12-bit +3 V voltage-output DAC with 16-bit serial interface, double-buffered inputs (LOADREG, LDAC) and reset to zero or mid scale
device.note: dac7617.pdf (SBAS185) p.2 (specifications: VDD 3.0-3.6 V, logic levels, straight binary), p.4 (pin configurations and descriptions), p.11 (digital interface, Table I timing, Figure 2), p.12 (Table II control logic, Table III shift register, double buffering, coding)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: input register A (Table II, A1 A0 select it; loaded from the shift register while LOADREG is low); power-on code not stated (reset 0)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: input register B (Table II, A1 A0 select it; loaded from the shift register while LOADREG is low); power-on code not stated (reset 0)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: input register C (Table II, A1 A0 select it; loaded from the shift register while LOADREG is low); power-on code not stated (reset 0)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: input register D (Table II, A1 A0 select it; loaded from the shift register while LOADREG is low); power-on code not stated (reset 0)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC register A; all four transparent while LDAC is low (Table II)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC register B; all four transparent while LDAC is low (Table II)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC register C; all four transparent while LDAC is low (Table II)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC register D; all four transparent while LDAC is low (Table II)

commands.name: Write
commands.note: 16-bit word A1 A0 X X D11-D0, MSB first, clocked on CLK rising while CS is low (Figure 2). The word goes to the input register A1 A0 select when LOADREG goes low (Table II); modeled as written into that input register when CS rises

protocol.note: write-only serial port (no SDO); CS and CLK are ORed into the shift-register clock, CS should rise only while CLK is high (p.11-12), hence mode 3

ldac.note: all DAC registers transparent while LDAC is low, latched while high (p.4 pin descriptions, Table II)

reset.note: asynchronous, level: all registers to 000H (RESETSEL low) or 800H (RESETSEL high) while RESET is low (Table II)

pages: p.2 (specifications: VDD 3.0-3.6 V, logic levels, straight binary), p.4 (pin configurations and descriptions), p.11 (digital interface, Table I timing, Figure 2), p.12 (Table II control logic, Table III shift register, double buffering, coding)
notModeled: analog: outputs, reference inputs VREFH/VREFL, settling (10 us)
power-on state of the registers is not stated in the datasheet (reset 0)
CS and CLK are interchangeable (ORed); a CS rising edge while CLK is low shifts one extra bit (p.11)

LOADREG: the input register A1 A0 select is transparent while LOADREG is low (level-triggered load from the shift register); the schema has no load-strobe pin, so the word is written into the input register when CS rises (a frame without a LOADREG pulse still updates the input register in the model)
variants: DAC7616 (dac7616.pdf) is the single-buffered sibling: no input registers, pin 13/17 NIC, LDAC loads the addressed DAC register only. DAC7617E/U/EB/UB are linearity grades of the same chip.
